data.title: 初音未来 · 录音棚
data.description: 【初音未来 · 录音棚】专业录音棚内柔和的暖光下，头戴大号监听耳机的初音未来站在防喷麦克风前，睫毛微颤全情投入地哼唱着由你谱写的新旋律。录制完毕后她摘下耳机兴奋地向你招手——「Master！刚才那一段副歌的情感表达怎么样？这次的新歌，我真的超级超级喜欢！」
data.action: 录音刚结束，一手拿下监听耳机，另一手向控制室挥手，防喷麦克风留在架上
data.promptProse: After the take, Miku removes her monitor headphones with one hand and waves toward the control-room window with the other. The condenser microphone and pop filter remain on their stand. Grey sleeveless collared top, teal tie, detached arm covers and dark pleated skirt retain her classic outfit. The medium view includes booth panels behind black square hair ornaments. Warm studio light catches turquoise eyes and headphone edges, leaving soft shadows behind the stationary microphone.
